gen-gf-overlock-sc-poppins: Overlock SC is a commanding display face with broad, open counters and little gap between its cases. Poppins is the opposite, drawn as a ribbon of constant width with a tall, sturdy body.
gen-gf-overlock-sc-roboto-slab: Distinctive in its own right, Overlock SC leans on broad open counters and barely any height shift between cases. And Roboto Slab, slab-serif and structured, packs its lowercase into a dense middle band that gives the pair its firm footing.
gen-gf-overlock-sc-rubik: Rubik reads soft and round, with lowercase that looks big beside its capitals. Overlock SC brings a commanding display voice, and the gap between that and Rubik's plain sans friendliness is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-overpass-fs-literata: Overpass draws bold letters with no thick-thin shift, like a steel cable outline, and its bowls tip open toward you. Literata's curves run a little heavier than its joins, so a longer read feels bookish and unhurried.
gen-gf-overpass-mono-fs-bespoke-sans: Fixed-width, code-style letters with a flat, stencil-like line weight set Overpass Mono apart right away. Bespoke Sans follows with sharp, refined curves that keep generous room before the stem, and that crisp openness is what ties the two.
gen-gf-overpass-mono-fs-literata: Overpass Mono has no contrast between stems and joins at all. Literata, a classic serif, adds a subtle thick-and-thin cadence beneath it, so the rigid code-style headings sit above text that moves with a bookish lilt.
gen-gf-oxygen-mono-fs-bespoke-sans: Typewriter-like letters with spacious gaps between characters make Oxygen Mono instantly recognizable, and its curves never crowd their own endings. Bespoke Sans is sharper and more refined, a plain sans with room at every stem.
gen-gf-oxygen-mono-fs-literata: Literata brings sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, with curved letters that stay wide open at the mouth. Oxygen Mono, structured and typewriter-spaced, holds its stem and connecting stroke nearly level, which is where the pair's sharpest difference lies.
gen-gf-palanquin-fs-literata: Palanquin is contemporary and approachable, with shapes that never clog even at low resolution. Make it small beside Literata, a classic serif, and its clarity still holds.
gen-gf-parastoo-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, with generous space where its curves meet the stem. And beneath Parastoo's traditional, editorial serif, a longer passage would move cleanly, the dense heading letters giving way to open ones.
